description: This file defines the TemplateMultiEnum class, a specialized form of TemplateEnum for handling multi-select enumeration fields in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering HTML, preparing data for saving, defining database schemas, and managing multilingual display options.

classes.name: TemplateMultiEnum
classes.description: A class extending TemplateEnum to handle multi-select enumeration fields with custom rendering and data management functionalities.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML code for editing the field in a form, rendering a multiple select box with options.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares an array for template rendering with the current selected options and help text.

methods.name: prepSave
methods.description: Placeholder for preparing data before saving; currently does nothing.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Alias for get_xtpl_detail, returning data for list views.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns an array with translated, comma-separated selected options for detail views.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns field definition array, including default values, dependencies, and multi-select indicators.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns an empty string as default database value for this field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and stores default and dependency information in ext4 for saving the field definition.
